title.narrative: Enhancing access to trauma care and support for medical patients and their families after exposure to violence, land mines and other explosive remnants of war

description.narrative: ltpgtUK-Med has been working in different hospitals since the start of the war, and since August 2023 has focused its surgical support in Zaporizhzhia-based hospitals which receive a high caseload of trauma injuries from war wounded near the frontlines of conflict. There is still a large unmet need for improved trauma care and support from the first point of contact to a health provider/last mile delivery partner, from trauma hospital wards, and on to discharge from hospital treatment. ltbrgtUnder this proposed project UK-Med would aim to deliver the following set of interventions to support the trauma pathway working in partnership with local organisations 100%Life, URC, and ICU.ltbrgt- Deployment of international clinical expertise (surgeons, nurses, IPC specialists) to support improved trauma treatment in hospitals in Zaporizhzhia.ltbrgt- Donation of trauma equipment and supplies to hospitals in Zaporizhzhialtbrgt- Dedicated management support to implement improving IPC practices in trauma wards in Zaporizhzhia hospitals (to be led by ICU)ltbrgt- Provision of trauma pathway training to clinicians and last-mile delivery partners in Zaporzhzhia, Dnipro and Donetsk Oblasts.ltbrgto Advanced Trauma Training for doctorsltbrgto Individual First Aid Kit Training (IFAK) for last mile delivery partners.ltbrgto Mass Casualty Incident Training for health facilities near the frontlines.ltbrgto E-FAST (Extended Focused Assessment with Sonography in Trauma) for emergency physicians.ltbrgto Advanced Life Support (ALS) and Basic Life Support (BLS) training for healthcare providers (to be led by URC).ltbrgt- Improved discharge support for trauma patients from Zaporizhzhia Oblast, including case management support and access to immediate legal and psychosocial services, with referral support to wider social-health services as required (to be led by 100% Life).ltbrgtlt/pgt
